summary: Frontend-only testing of CloudIVR UX Refresh across all signed-in pages. Login flow works correctly. All pages load successfully: Dashboard (stats ribbon with Wallet/Numbers/Unread/Minutes), Numbers (hub tabs, number cards with capability badges and quick switches), Wallet & billing (balance, deposit options, renewals), Usage (billing cycle data), Settings (account forms), Campaigns (campaign list), Inbox (notification list). Sidebar navigation works - all nav links clickable and navigate correctly. Top bar elements work - balance pill links to wallet, inbox bell links to inbox, search icon opens command palette. Mobile viewport (390x844): bottom nav appears with glassmorphism, sidebar hidden, pages usable with proper touch targets. Theme toggle works - switching between light and dark modes preserves layout. Number card quick switches (Forwarding, IVR, Hours, Fax) are clickable and visually respond with toast notifications.

issues: CRITICAL: theme-2026.css is being overridden by theme-air.css (loaded last in theme.js). The accent color shows as emerald green (#047857) instead of the blue (#3b82f6) specified in theme-2026.css. The page title font shows as 'Geist' instead of 'Barlow Condensed' as specified in theme-2026.css.
CSS load order in theme.js: theme-light.css -> theme-clean.css -> theme-2026.css -> mobile-app.css -> theme-air.css. Since theme-air.css is loaded LAST, it overrides the theme-2026.css values.

theme-air.css sets: --c-accent: #047857 (emerald), font-family: 'Geist', 'Plus Jakarta Sans' - these override the theme-2026.css values of --c-accent: #3b82f6 (blue) and font-family: 'Barlow Condensed'

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix CSS load order - theme-2026.css should be loaded LAST in theme.js to ensure its styles take precedence, OR remove/consolidate theme-air.css if it's not needed
Alternatively, increase specificity of theme-2026.css selectors to override theme-air.css
Verify the intended accent color: theme-2026.css specifies blue (#3b82f6) but theme-air.css specifies emerald (#047857) - clarify which is correct for the 2026 UX refresh
critical_code_review_comments: theme.js imports CSS in order: theme-light.css, theme-clean.css, theme-2026.css, mobile-app.css, theme-air.css - the last file wins for conflicting rules
theme-2026.css has comprehensive CSS tokens and component overrides but they are being overridden by theme-air.css
The Barlow Condensed font IS loaded (confirmed via document.fonts) but not applied because theme-air.css sets font-family to Geist
Quick switches on number cards work correctly - they toggle state and show toast notifications with Undo option
Mobile bottom nav has proper glassmorphism styling and touch targets (min-height: 44px on touch devices)

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: CSS cascade order. theme.js imports theme-2026.css before theme-air.css, so theme-air.css rules (which have the same specificity) override theme-2026.css. Both files target html[data-civr-theme] .civr selectors with the same specificity, so the last-loaded file wins. Fix: Either reorder imports in theme.js to load theme-2026.css last, or increase specificity of theme-2026.css selectors, or consolidate the theme files.
